title: introduce-tenant-throttle-lattice-and-utilization-sentinel
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: tenant allocation and throttling heuristics have produced oscillatory behavior in multi-tenant fleets where sudden short-lived spikes cause aggressive scaling followed by underutilized capacity. This PR introduces two coordinated mechanisms: (1) a Tenant Throttle Lattice - a multi-dimensional, soft-throttle lattice that composes concurrency, route-level rate, and ephemeral throughput bands to provide smooth, priority-aware degradation; (2) a Utilization Sentinel - a composite telemetry signal that fuses GPU occupancy, KV-cache hit-rate, queue latency P95, and model step time into a single utilization score used by autoscalers and the operator console. Goals: reduce autoscaler churn on short spikes, add an explicit soft-floor for high-priority tenants, and surface a more robust utilization signal that prevents misattribution of load. Changes are scoped to the autoscaler, runtime metrics exporter, controller config, and observability dashboards. Checklist: - [x] Implement lattice data model and enforcement layer - [x] Emit sentinel metrics and register Prometheus counters/histograms - [x] Backfill unit tests for lattice transitions and sentinel smoothing - [x] Add e2e load test harness with synthetic tenant traffic patterns - [x] Docs: configuration guide and console dashboard snippets - [x] Canary rollout plan and operator feature flag (runtime.enableThrottleLattice) Backwards compatibility: lattice is behind a feature flag and defaults to off for existing Dedicated clusters. Sentinel metrics are additive and do not change existing metric names; new composite metrics prefixed with rwd_sentinel_ are introduced. Rollout: feature-flag canary to 10% of Dedicated fleets for 48 hours with fast rollback. Migration notes: operators should validate sentinel.calibration_window and tenant.priority_tiers in config before enabling. Impact: aims to reduce scale-up bounce by ~40% in internal benchmarks for mixed-criticality workloads while preserving SLOs for high-priority tenants.

Maya Chen (2026-02-20): Fixed in f3d7b11, added sentinel_test for empty window behavior and fallback path (returns 0 utilization).

Sofia Rivera (2026-02-22): Can we ensure the enforcement path respects per-route overrides and that priority_tiers are consulted before soft-throttle ramps? Also suggest telemetry tag to mark enforcement decisions for auditability.

Maya Chen (2026-02-22): Enforcement now checks per-route overrides; added rwd_throttle_decision{reason,..} metric and a lightweight audit event emitted to operator log stream. Unit tests cover priority ordering.
